caption:
Prices and interest rates are in the news again. 📊

BLS says consumer prices rose 3.7% in September compared with a year earlier. The Federal Reserve held interest rates steady last week after raising them in September.

In plain English: things still cost more than last year, and borrowing isn't getting cheaper yet.

What price are you feeling most right now?
first_comment: Which price jumped the most in your life this year? 👇
